solar_panels.detail: The central house roof is uniform gray shingle. The solar array is on the neighboring house to the left, which is not the central lot.

signals.notes: Central house has a gray, fairly uniform roof with a small deck or patio area on its west side, and a driveway running north to the street with one white car. Dense mature tree canopy covers the entire rear and south side of the lot, so the backyard cannot be seen.
